+"""Capture real desktop/mobile screenshots against a local Streamlit process."""
+
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import requests
+from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+
+def main():
+    environment = dict(os.environ, WILDFIRE_USE_SAMPLE="1", PYTHONIOENCODING="utf-8")
+    stdout = (ROOT / "reports/evidence/dashboard-server.txt").open("w", encoding="utf-8")
+    stderr = (ROOT / "reports/evidence/dashboard-stderr.txt").open("w", encoding="utf-8")
+    command = [sys.executable, "-m", "streamlit", "run", "app/streamlit_app.py", "--server.headless=true",
+               "--server.port=8505", "--browser.gatherUsageStats=false"]
+    process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=ROOT, env=environment, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr,
+                               creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW if os.name == "nt" else 0)
+    try:
+        for _ in range(60):
+            try:
+                if requests.get("http://localhost:8505/_stcore/health", timeout=2).ok:
+                    break
+            except requests.RequestException:
+                pass
+            time.sleep(1)
+        else:
+            raise RuntimeError("Streamlit did not become healthy")
+        with sync_playwright() as playwright:
+            browser = playwright.chromium.launch(executable_path=r"C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe", headless=True)
+            errors = []
+            page = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 1100})
+            page.on("pageerror", lambda error: errors.append(str(error)))
+            page.goto("http://localhost:8505", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
+            page.get_by_text("Cells Shown", exact=False).first.wait_for(timeout=120000)
+            page.wait_for_timeout(4000)
+            if page.locator('[data-testid="stException"]').count():
+                raise RuntimeError(page.locator('[data-testid="stException"]').inner_text())
+            page.screenshot(path=str(ROOT / "reports/figures/dashboard-desktop.png"), full_page=True)
+            for label in ["Cell Ranking", "SHAP Explanation", "Model Health", "About"]:
+                page.get_by_role("tab", name=label, exact=False).click()
+                page.wait_for_timeout(400)
+                if page.locator('[data-testid="stException"]').count():
+                    raise RuntimeError("Dashboard tab failed: " + label)
+            page.get_by_role("tab", name="Risk Map", exact=False).click()
+            page.set_viewport_size({"width": 390, "height": 844})
+            page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
+            page.locator('iframe').first.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
+            page.screenshot(path=str(ROOT / "reports/figures/dashboard-mobile.png"), full_page=True)
+            browser.close()
+        result = {"url": "http://localhost:8505", "mode": "real versioned historical demonstration sample",
+                  "browser_errors": errors, "tabs_checked": 5, "viewports": [[1440, 1100], [390, 844]],
+                  "screenshots": ["reports/figures/dashboard-desktop.png", "reports/figures/dashboard-mobile.png"]}
+        (ROOT / "reports/evidence/dashboard-browser.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
+        print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
+    finally:
+        process.terminate()
+        process.wait(timeout=20)
+        stdout.close()
+        stderr.close()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Extract a contiguous demonstration interval from actual processed observations."""
+
+import json
+
+import pandas as pd
+
+from src.config import get_project_root
+from src.data.manifest import compute_sha256
+
+
+def main():
+    root = get_project_root()
+    output = root / "data/sample"
+    grid = pd.read_csv(root / "data/processed/grid.csv")
+    grid = grid[grid.state_status != "outside"]
+    source = root / "data/processed/features.parquet"
+    filters = [("date", ">=", pd.Timestamp("2024-08-12")), ("date", "<=", pd.Timestamp("2024-08-18"))]
+    frame = pd.read_parquet(source, filters=filters)
+    frame = frame[frame.grid_id.isin(grid.grid_id)].sort_values(["grid_id", "date"])
+    frame.to_parquet(output / "features_sample.parquet", index=False)
+    grid.to_csv(output / "grid_sample.csv", index=False)
+    raw = pd.read_parquet(root / "data/processed/dataset.parquet", filters=filters)
+    raw = raw[raw.grid_id.isin(grid.grid_id)]
+    raw[["date", "grid_id", "T2M_MAX", "T2M_MIN", "RH2M", "PRECTOTCORR", "WS10M"]].to_csv(output / "climate_sample.csv", index=False)
+    metadata = {"purpose": "Historical demonstration, not an unbiased evaluation sample",
+                "selection": "All territorial cells, 2024-08-12 through 2024-08-18 inclusive; observed records only",
+                "rows": len(frame), "cells": frame.grid_id.nunique(), "source_features_sha256": compute_sha256(source),
+                "sample_sha256": compute_sha256(output / "features_sample.parquet")}
+    (output / "sample_metadata.json").write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
+    print(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Strict registration of completed experiment artifacts; failures propagate."""
+
+import importlib.metadata
+import json
+import platform
+import re
+import subprocess
+
+from src.config import get_project_root
+from src.data.manifest import compute_sha256
+
+
+def register_results(root=None, tracking_uri=None):
+    import mlflow
+    root = root or get_project_root()
+    metadata = json.loads((root / "models/training_metadata.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    uri = tracking_uri or f"sqlite:///{(root / 'mlflow-audit.db').resolve()}"
+    names = ["feature_cols.joblib", "lightgbm_model.joblib", "lightgbm_1d.joblib", "lightgbm_3d.joblib",
+             "platt_calibrator.joblib", "platt_calibrator_1d.joblib", "platt_calibrator_3d.joblib",
+             "logistic_regression.joblib", "logistic_calibrator.joblib", "scaler.joblib"]
+    if (root / "reports/research/matched_lstm_metadata.json").exists():
+        names += ["lstm_model.pt", "lstm_calibrator.joblib", "lstm_preprocessing.joblib"]
+    artifacts = [root / "models" / name for name in names]
+    mlflow.set_tracking_uri(uri)
+    mlflow.set_experiment("brazil-wildfire-risk-forecast-audit")
+    snapshot = {"registration_commit": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=root, text=True).strip(),
+                "training_metadata_commit": metadata.get("commit"), "seed": metadata["seed"],
+                "python": platform.python_version(), "registration_note": "Registration snapshot; consult execution logs and metadata for training provenance.",
+                "versions": {name: importlib.metadata.version(name) for name in ["lightgbm", "scikit-learn", "numpy", "pandas", "mlflow", "sqlalchemy"]},
+                "files": {path.relative_to(root).as_posix(): compute_sha256(path)
+                          for path in artifacts},
+                "data_features_sha256": compute_sha256(root / "data/processed/features.parquet"),
+                "environment_lock_sha256": compute_sha256(root / "requirements.lock")}
+    output = root / "reports/evidence/mlflow-registration.json"
+    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with mlflow.start_run(run_name="retrospective-audit-registration") as run:
+        mlflow.log_params(metadata["best_params"])
+        mlflow.log_params({key: metadata[key] for key in ["seed", "train_size", "calibration_size", "test_size"]})
+        mlflow.set_tags({"training_commit": str(metadata.get("commit")), "registration_commit": snapshot["registration_commit"],
+                         "features_sha256": snapshot["data_features_sha256"], "lock_sha256": snapshot["environment_lock_sha256"]})
+        for row in metadata["model_comparison"]:
+            name = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9_]+", "_", row["model"].lower()).strip("_")
+            for key in ["AP", "ROC-AUC", "Brier", "ECE"]:
+                mlflow.log_metric(f"{name}_{key}", float(row[key]))
+        for path in artifacts:
+            mlflow.log_artifact(str(path), artifact_path="models")
+        for path in (root / "reports").glob("*.csv"):
+            mlflow.log_artifact(str(path), artifact_path="reports")
+        mlflow.log_artifact(str(root / "models/training_metadata.json"))
+        mlflow.log_artifact(str(root / "requirements.lock"))
+        mlflow.log_dict(snapshot, "registration-provenance.json")
+        snapshot["run_id"] = run.info.run_id
+        snapshot["tracking_uri"] = uri
+    record = mlflow.MlflowClient().get_run(snapshot["run_id"])
+    if record.info.status != "FINISHED" or len(record.data.metrics) < 4:
+        raise RuntimeError("MLflow run did not persist expected metrics")
+    snapshot["verified_status"] = record.info.status
+    snapshot["verified_metrics"] = len(record.data.metrics)
+    output.write_text(json.dumps(snapshot, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
+    print(f"MLflow verified: run={snapshot['run_id']}, metrics={snapshot['verified_metrics']}", flush=True)
+    return snapshot
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    register_results()

diff --git a/src/reporting/generate_research_tables.py b/src/reporting/generate_research_tables.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..16cfd03
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/reporting/generate_research_tables.py
@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+"""Synchronize controlled research tables; preserve the surrounding narrative."""
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+
+import pandas as pd
+
+from src.config import get_project_root
+from src.reporting.generate_readme_metrics import markdown_table
+
+BEGIN = "<!-- BEGIN GENERATED RESEARCH -->"
+END = "<!-- END GENERATED RESEARCH -->"
+
+
+def render_research(root):
+    folder = root / "reports/research"
+    metadata = json.loads((folder / "metadata.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    for key, path in [("primary_model_sha256", root / "models/lightgbm_model.joblib"),
+                      ("primary_calibrator_sha256", root / "models/platt_calibrator.joblib")]:
+        if metadata.get(key) != hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest():
+            raise ValueError(f"Stale research model provenance: {key}")
+    nofire = pd.read_csv(folder / "no_recent_fire.csv")
+    main = nofire[(nofire["group"] == "all") & (nofire.subset == "no_local_30d")].copy()
+    main["AP 95% CI"] = main.apply(lambda row: f"[{row['PR-AUC_95CI_low']:.4f}, {row['PR-AUC_95CI_high']:.4f}]", axis=1)
+    nofire_text = markdown_table(main[["model", "n", "prevalence", "AP", "AP 95% CI", "ROC-AUC", "Brier", "ECE", "Precision@Top10%", "Recall@Top10%"]])
+    nofire_text += "\n\n" + markdown_table(nofire[(nofire["group"] == "all") & nofire.model.isin(["LightGBM", "Climatology"])][["subset", "model", "n", "prevalence", "AP", "ROC-AUC", "Brier"]])
+    spatial = pd.read_csv(folder / "spatial_generalization.csv")
+    spatial_text = markdown_table(spatial[["held_region", "model", "train_n", "calibration_n", "n", "prevalence", "AP", "ROC-AUC", "Brier", "ECE"]])
+    ablation = pd.read_csv(folder / "ablation.csv")
+    oracle = pd.read_csv(folder / "oracle.csv")
+    climate_text = markdown_table(ablation[["model", "features", "n", "AP", "ROC-AUC", "Brier", "ECE"]])
+    climate_text += "\n\n" + markdown_table(oracle[["model", "n", "AP", "ROC-AUC", "Brier", "ECE"]])
+    matched = pd.read_csv(folder / "matched_lstm.csv")
+    matched_meta = json.loads((folder / "matched_lstm_metadata.json").read_text())
+    paired = matched_meta["paired_AP_difference"]
+    matched_text = markdown_table(matched[["model", "n", "AP", "ROC-AUC", "Brier", "ECE", "Precision@Top10%", "Recall@Top10%"]])
+    matched_text += f"\n\nTraining rows: {matched_meta['training_rows']:,}; calibration: {matched_meta['calibration_rows']:,}; test: {matched_meta['test_rows']:,}. "
+    matched_text += f"Paired delta AP (LightGBM minus LSTM): {paired['observed_delta_AP']:.4f}, 95% CI [{paired['delta_AP_95CI'][0]:.4f}, {paired['delta_AP_95CI'][1]:.4f}]."
+    return {"SEM_FOGO_RECENTE.md": nofire_text, "GENERALIZACAO_ESPACIAL.md": spatial_text,
+            "CLIMA_E_ABLACAO.md": climate_text, "COMPARACAO_JUSTA_MODELOS.md": matched_text}
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    root = get_project_root()
+    for name, table in render_research(root).items():
+        path = root / "reports" / name
+        content = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        if content.count(BEGIN) != 1 or content.count(END) != 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"Invalid controlled region in {name}")
+        prefix, rest = content.split(BEGIN)
+        _, suffix = rest.split(END)
+        expected = prefix + BEGIN + "\n\n" + table + "\n\n" + END + suffix
+        if args.check and content != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f"Stale research tables: {name}")
+        if not args.check:
+            path.write_text(expected, encoding="utf-8")
+    print("Research documentation verified" if args.check else "Research tables generated")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+"""Documentation must agree with the experiment, not with copied literals."""
+
+import json
+import shutil
+
+import pandas as pd
+import pytest
+
+from src.config import get_project_root
+from src.reporting.generate_readme_metrics import render, update_document, validated_tables
+
+
+def test_generated_docs_are_current():
+    root = get_project_root()
+    generated = render(root)
+    for name in ["README.md", "README.pt-BR.md", "reports/VALIDACAO_CIENTIFICA.md"]:
+        update_document(root / name, generated, check=True)
+
+
+def test_reporting_rejects_conflicting_metrics(tmp_path):
+    root = get_project_root()
+    (tmp_path / "models").mkdir()
+    (tmp_path / "reports").mkdir()
+    shutil.copy(root / "models/training_metadata.json", tmp_path / "models/training_metadata.json")
+    for name in ["model_comparison.csv", "multi_horizon_comparison.csv", "operational_decision_metrics.csv"]:
+        shutil.copy(root / "reports" / name, tmp_path / "reports" / name)
+    frame = pd.read_csv(tmp_path / "reports/model_comparison.csv")
+    frame.loc[0, "AP"] = .12345
+    frame.to_csv(tmp_path / "reports/model_comparison.csv", index=False)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="mismatch"):
+        validated_tables(tmp_path)
+
+
+def test_no_climate_ablation_excludes_rainfall_accumulations():
+    root = get_project_root()
+    metadata = json.loads((root / "reports/research/metadata.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    features = metadata["ablation_features"]["No climate"]
+    assert not any("prec" in f.lower() for f in features)
+    assert len(features) == 11
+
+
+def test_matched_lstm_report_records_identical_evaluation_rows():
+    root = get_project_root()
+    frame = pd.read_csv(root / "reports/research/matched_lstm.csv")
+    metadata = json.loads((root / "reports/research/matched_lstm_metadata.json").read_text())
+    assert frame.n.nunique() == 1
+    assert frame.n.iloc[0] == metadata["test_rows"]
+    assert metadata["same_labels_and_keys_verified"] is True
+    assert metadata["training_stride"] == metadata["test_stride"] == 1
